structured_requirements.final_statement: The payment service shall be available for the entire duration of the business day, but may be unavailable during the specific time blocks allocated for maintenance and upgrades.
structuring_notes: Core predicate is 'available' (measurable property of performance) → quality_requirement. Ambiguity AMB-01 resolved: 'available 100% of the time' replaced with supported interpretation regarding business day availability and maintenance exclusions.
